subject: Headcount & band variance request — Olivia Santos (CTF -> FTE)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: headcount + band variance for contractor -> FTE (Olivia Santos)
Attachments: Olivia_Santos_resume.pdf (PDF)

Hi Monica / Lauren / Vivek,

Olivia Santos (contractor via Atlas Talent) joined the Recommendations team in Feb on a 6-month contract and has been covering a senior SWE scope for the personalization ranking work. She is finishing her contract on 12/15 and we've been discussing converting her to FTE. Quick summary: 
- Current contractor billing: $90/hr (W2 equivalent)
- Role we want to convert her into: Senior Software Engineer II (IC3)
- Standard comp band for IC3 (San Francisco metro / remote-US): $140k–$160k base
- Olivia's ask: $160k base + standard RSU target for IC3

Performance: excellent; consistently delivered two cross-team initiatives and reduced inference latency for the ranking model by ~8%. Manager feedback attached in the resume doc.

Asking for two approvals here: 1) headcount to convert the contractor role to an open FTE on the Recommendations team (backfill the contractor slot), and 2) a band variance to allow Olivia to join at $160k (top of band) due to market and retention risk. I attached her resume and a short cost comparison (contractor vs proposed FTE).

If approved, I plan to extend an offer with a standard benefits package and a 4-week notice window for the agency. Timeline: need sign-off by 12/01 to ensure we get started before contract end.

Proposed next steps: Monica to confirm HR/comp eligibility and paperwork, Rachel to confirm budget reallocation, Lauren/Vivek to sign off on band variance.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: headcount + band variance for contractor -> FTE (Olivia Santos)

Ben / Monica —

Thanks for flagging this. I fully endorse converting Olivia to FTE and supporting the $160k ask. A few notes from the manager perspective: 
- Olivia has taken ownership of three major PRs and is already mentoring two junior engineers.
- We expect her to carry an individual OKR tied to model quality and infra cost optimizations; losing her would create at least a 6-8 week ramp for a new hire.

Budget standpoint: I have ~0.6 FTE capacity in my current headcount plan if we reallocate an open contractor line to FTE; that covers base + benefits at the $160k level for H1 (we may need to reprioritize a hiring freeze bucket elsewhere to avoid headcount overshoot).

If comp needs justification for variance, I suggest we cite market comps for SF area IC3s and her direct impact on cost. My preference is to offer $160k base + 8% annual bonus target + RSU target typical of IC3.

Ben — once Monica confirms People Ops paperwork, please pull the proposed offer packet and band variance form so Rachel can review the budget impact.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, Recommendations
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: headcount + band variance for contractor -> FTE (Olivia Santos)
Attachments: band_variance_form.docx, proposed_offer_packet.pdf

Thanks — this looks good and timely. A few process notes: 
1) Band variance form filled out and attached; it needs manager sign-off (Lauren) and finance approval (Rachel).
2) For headcount, we need written confirmation that an existing contractor slot will be reapedportioned to FTE (Ben — please confirm with procurement/Atlas that we will not incur overlap charges beyond a 2-week handover).
3) Olivia's eligibility: since she was a >6-month contractor on W2, she is eligible for standard FTE benefits and equity grant. Agency fees are in the vendor contract and should not exceed one month of billing once converted — I've looped procurement separately.

Please review the attached offer packet draft (Ben: review the title and job level language). If Lauren signs the variance form and Rachel confirms budget, I will route to People Ops and draft a formal offer letter.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner

Team —

I reviewed the band variance form and the proposed offer packet. Finance approves the headcount conversion and the band variance to allow Olivia to join at $160,000 base. Notes: 
- We will temporarily reclass the contractor line to FTE under the Recommendations cost center for Q4; no additional incremental headcount budget is required this fiscal year.
- Please ensure the onboarding cost (equipment + sign-on processing) is charged to the hiring manager's cost center (Lauren).
- Equity committee: RSU grant at IC3 level is approved pending final offer sign-off by People Ops.

Monica — please proceed to generate the formal offer and route through DocuSign. Ben — please coordinate with Atlas Talent to confirm the last billing date and close the contractor engagement to avoid duplicate charges.
